document.title: Eval runner: per-run skill snapshot, repeats, shared cache
document.summary: The eval runner snapshots the skill once per run, adds `--repeat`, `--jobs`, `--skill`, and `--keep`, shares one locked clone cache and the main checkout's `.env` across worktrees, and `docs/eval.md` is rewritten to match.
document.why: Agents that run evals lose 30+ minutes per session, partly from a stale [docs/eval.md](source:s1) and partly from runner gaps such as skill edits that leak into later cases.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Nov 5
sources.gist: Retro of 10 eval sessions: snapshot the skill per run, add --repeat and --skill, share .env and the clone cache across worktrees, fix args help, and rewrite docs/eval.md with debrief, CI artifact, and flaky-expect sections.

lookFor: The task asks for a smoke eval and a `--repeat 2` run as proof. Both ran, but every producer call got Muse error 402 (billing verification failed), so no review was produced and the debrief command was not tried on a real session.
The task gives `.gitignore` to this change. It is unchanged: `eval/.cache/` stays ignored so old caches in existing checkouts do not show up as untracked files.

groups.title: Skill snapshot per run
groups.why: An agent that edited SKILL.md during a run leaked the edit into the cases that started later [in 3 sessions](source:s1).
groups.summary: `snapshotSkill` copies the skill folder once, hashes the copy with a throwaway git index, then rewrites the CLI pin, so the hash matches `HEAD:<skill dir>` for a clean skill.

attention.note: `skillTree` in `summary.json` is now the tree of the copy that ran, not `HEAD:skills-next/comprehende`. With uncommitted skill edits the value names no commit, and `run.ts` prints a warning. Check that nothing compares `skillTree` to a commit tree.

fileNotes.scripts/eval/skill.ts: Replaces `copySkillForEval` with `snapshotSkill` plus a tree hash.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/skill.test.ts: Proves a clean copy hashes to the committed tree, a dirty one does not.

groups.title: Shared clone cache and worktree .env
groups.why: Delegate worktrees symlinked `.env` by hand, and the clone cache under `eval/.cache` was per checkout and raced on first use [in parallel runs](source:s1).
groups.summary: `checkout.ts` finds the git common dir; `loadDotEnv` reads the worktree `.env` and then the main checkout's, and `cloneCaseFromCache` fills the shared cache under a lock before it hardlink-clones a private bare repo for the case.

attention.note: `withLock` holds the cache entry through the first clone, the fetch, and the hardlink clone. Parallel cases of one repo queue there, so a cold ruff clone blocks every other ruff case until it ends. A lock whose owner pid is dead, or that has no pid after 60 seconds, is taken over.

fileNotes.scripts/eval/checkout.ts: New: cache dir and main checkout from `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/env.ts: Loads the worktree `.env`, then the main checkout's.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/env.test.ts: Worktree value wins; main fills the missing key.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/clone.test.ts: Four parallel cold-cache clones, and a dead-owner lock takeover.

groups.title: Run loop: trials, jobs, keep
groups.why: Two sessions wrote throwaway harnesses to run one case 20 times and to compare skill variants, and a debrief needs the producer's clone [after the case ends](source:s1).
groups.summary: `runEval` snapshots the skill once, expands each case into `--repeat` trials, and runs them through `mapPool` with `--jobs` in flight; `caseKey` names each trial `<id>.t<n>` in folders, lines, and the report.

attention.note: With `--repeat 1` (the default) case folders stay `<id>/`, so CI artifacts and `--baseline` keep their paths. A repeated run writes `<id>.t<n>/`, so `--rescore` and `--baseline` on it need the same `--repeat` to find each trial.

fileNotes.scripts/eval/run.ts: `CaseMode` union, skill snapshot, trial pool, `--keep` skips temp cleanup.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/args.ts: New flags; help says the grader checks each claim.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/args.test.ts: Parses the new flags and rejects bad counts.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/report.ts: Anchors and links use `caseKey`; header names a `--skill` folder.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/report.test.ts: Pass counts per case and per-trial links.

groups.title: docs/eval.md
groups.why: Stale eval docs cost agents time: a tmux and `AwaitShell` recipe that does not apply, a too-broad one-process rule, and no debrief or CI artifact guide [per the retro](source:s1).
groups.summary: "Long runs" now says to build once before parallel `run.ts` streams and to kill by cwd, and new sections cover debriefing a kept session, CI artifact paths, and known flaky expects.

commits.subject: Eval: snapshot the skill per run, add --repeat, --jobs, --skill, --keep
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The run copies the skill once at start, so edits during a run no longer leak into later cases, and skillTree records the tree of that copy. Worktrees read the main checkout's .env and share one clone cache under the git common dir, filled under a lock. Each case gets its own bare clone. docs/eval.md covers parallel streams, stopping a run, debriefing a kept session, CI artifacts, and known flaky expects.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
